extra_nodes.name: Application development
extra_nodes.description: Application development is the largest share of what we do. We build software for the surface it actually runs on, native mobile, web and desktop, automotive and Android Automotive, wearables, and VR, and we wire it into the enterprise systems and SaaS behind it.

extra_nodes.name: AI engineering
extra_nodes.description: We build production systems on foundation models, not slideware. That means retrieval that returns the right context, evaluation pipelines that tell you when the model is wrong, deployment into your environment including on-prem and sovereign cloud, and observability so you can see what the system is doing after it ships.

extra_nodes.name: Cloud platforms
extra_nodes.description: We build and run cloud platforms for regulated industries, on GCP, AWS, and on-prem hybrids. The goal is boring infrastructure: pipelines that stay green, deployments you can reason about, and a bill that matches what you actually use.
